text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, found some new cosmeytics~~! This'll 
match tomorrow's date outfit perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Mayano, you must be so, so excited~~☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Because it's finally here! My 
amusement park date with Papa☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna escort him with Maya's special 
plan! Meet up at a cafe, tour the 
amusement park, eat fluffy soufflés~~...♪

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow's outdoor festival is cancelled, 
apparently. Seriously the absolute worst.

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text:
Can't be helped. They said it's gonna pour 
down crazy hard.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh, no way...? Tomorrow was supposed to 
be sunny, right? I checked the weather 
forecast and everything!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! The forecast changed! It says heavy 
rain everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Mayano's Father
text_block_list.text:
"...It sounds like almost all the 
attractions at the amusement park will be 
shut down. It's a shame, but we should 
probably cancel our plans."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Mayano's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Don't look so down. My cute little Maya 
planned a whole date just for her Papa! 
Just that alone made me so incredibly 
happy..."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Papa was... looking forward to it so 
much... A date with Maya...)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(In that case, giving up is even more 
frustrating... To just let it all wash 
away in the rain...)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Both me and Papa were super thrilled. I 
don't wanna stop this excitement after 
all!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—Papa! Let's still go on our date 
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Mayano's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? But because of the rain, the 
plans..."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: It's okay! Leave it to Maya!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone! Please tell Maya your best 
recommendations for rainy days!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Mayano? What's going on?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm making a brand-new date plan right 
now, and I need as much info as possible!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
There's not much time left, but I 
definitely won't give up...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Even on a rainy day, I want it to be the 
best date ever!! So please!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let me suggest a few 
candidates. I'm sure you can put together 
the perfect plan, little pony-chan.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Fuji-senpai! Thank you so much~~!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Me too! There's a Western restaurant that 
serves a rainy-day-only menu~♪ It's super 
buono!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Even pouring rain can be marvelous☆ Like a 
book cafe filled with the gentle 
pitter-patter of raindrops, there are 
sooooo many marvelous spots★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... yeah, yeah! Please tell me 
lots more!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hm-hm~hm, hm-hm-hm~n...♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano's Father
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, Maya.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—Papa! No, Maya just got here too! Was the 
rain alright?

text_block_list.name: Mayano's Father
text_block_list.text:
Haha, if it's to see my beloved Maya, a 
little rain is nothing! So, where are you 
taking me today?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You know what, you know what?! Maya's 
friends told her about so many places! 
Places that sparkle and excite even in the 
rain!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then! Maya came up with it! 
A date plan packed with tons of fun for 
the two of us!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: So—here! Hold my hand!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya will escort you all day today! On the 
absolute beeeest rainy-day date!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, after the rain had cleared. 
While walking through the academy, I 
spotted Mayano Top Gun.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Hey, hey, I'll give you some too! A 
little share of happiness!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I went on a date with Papa yesterday! 
These are souvenirs from it!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The amusement park fell through because of 
the rain, but instead, we toured all kinds 
of backup date spots!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The most important thing is "having fun 
together", right?♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Mayano Top Gun spoke so happily, she 
looked somehow remarkably grown-up.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Listen, listen! I went on a date with 
Papa yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Since we changed plans at the last minute, 
not everything went smoothly. But still, 
it was so much fun~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So next time, I want to make it a truly 
perfect date!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely want your advice when the 
time comes! Count on it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Mayano Top Gun laughed innocently, she 
was endearing in a way perfectly fitting a 
girl her age.
